answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Innovations & Customs Question ID: 49533 Country: India Title: Ammavasa and Poornima in Islam Question: Please let me know the status of Amavasa (Dark Night) and Poormnima (Full Moon Night) in Islam. Can a Muslim hold a marriage in the night of Amavasa and Poormnima. Answer ID: 49533 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 25/25/M=01/1435) It would have been far better had you written the concept and belief of people regarding Amavasa (Dark Night) and Poormnima (Full Moon Night) in order to learn the Islamic ruling regarding it. However, Muslims can marry in Amavasa and Poormnima; there is no harm in it. It is wrong concept what people consider marrying during these nights as evil omen. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
